title: Generalized Fallback Installers — ecosystem routes when no native package manager covers the OS
scope: Declarative `fallback: { go|npm|cargo|uv: "<first-party pkg>" }` slot on define_tool!. Platform slots always win; on is_no_platform_installer() the runtime takes fallback routes in declared order, auto-installing the missing ecosystem toolchain through jarvy's own registry (go/nvm+node/rustup/uv all have first-party routes) before running the route. Python route is `uv tool install` (isolated, no PEP-668 issues), NOT pip. HARD REQUIREMENT: ecosystem package managers only — no curl|sh fallbacks ever. Package strings pass validate_package_name. Install receipts (~/.jarvy/install-receipts.json, doctor-cache-style stat signature for staleness) route fallback-installed tools to the right check-updates probe and make receipt-aware `jarvy upgrade` work. tool.installed gains install_route + toolchain_bootstrapped; tool.unsupported fires only when all routes exhausted. betterleaks is the first consumer (deletes its bespoke custom_install, 4cadf92); ~20 'no first-party winget manifest' tools are migration candidates. Full PRD: tasks/prd-060-fallback-installers.md
follow_up: Phase 1 DONE (2026-08-03): FallbackRoute type + macro slot + go/npm/cargo/uv runtime + toolchain bootstrap (registry::add + forget_has PATH-cache eviction) + receipt WRITES (~/.jarvy/install-receipts.json) + validation gauntlet + telemetry (install_route/toolchain_bootstrapped/fallback_declared/fallback_blocked/tool.fallback_failed/tool.receipt_write_failed) + betterleaks migration off bespoke custom_install

Phase 2 DONE (2026-08-04): receipt READS (load_valid/lookup/remove + resolver routing with receipt_package_safe hostile-input gauntlet + push_target pkg dedup) + UvBackend (PyPI JSON via bounded_fetch) + receipt-aware `jarvy upgrade` (+ --native flag: skips receipt, deletes it after native success) + setup dry-run / diff fallback-route preview (fallback::preview_route) + candidate audit: 8 migrated (cfn-lint/locust/glances uv, allure npm, kafkactl/nats-server/kubent/argo go), 5 excluded (helmfile/temporal/velero/clusterctl replace directives; kubeseal module-path mismatch)
DEVIATION: cache gained NO route field — CacheStore key is '{backend}:{pkg_id}', so a route change is an automatic miss
DEVIATION: readers never prune receipts (treated-as-absent only); writers = fallback install + upgrade --native delete
DEVIATION: no `uv tool list` batching — no [uv] config section; UvBackend only serves receipt-routed targets
DECIDED: UvBackend latest-version probe = PyPI JSON API via net::bounded_fetch (uv dry-run output not a stable contract)
DECIDED: toolchain bootstrap distro-vs-linuxbrew ordering = tool-def ordering as-is, no special casing
DECIDED: jarvy diff / dry-run preview shows fallback route — yes, Phase 2
DECIDED: already-installed tools never enter fallback — cmd_satisfies skip-detection fires before install(); no receipt for pre-existing installs
RESOLVED (2026-08-04): go-route freshness for cmd/ subpaths — GoBackend::module_candidate lexically truncates at /cmd/ (min 3 segments), probes module first, NotFound retries full path
